versions.changelog:
ai-viral-team-script-writing v1.0.0

- Initial release of the short video scriptwriting and storyboard skill.
- Supports structured script and storyboard design with detailed English prompts for Vidu video generation.
- Guides users through stepwise script output (framework then full script) and ensures character consistency.
- Integrates with trending analysis, video generation, and quality check functions.
- Offers explicit templates and keyword references for scene, camera, mood, and transition descriptions.
